newsitem.title: USA: Northern States Power to provide energy to Sears.
newsitem.headline: Northern States Power to provide energy to Sears.

text.p: Northern States Power Co said Monday it joined an eight-company regional power alliance that would provide electricity to Sears, Roebuck and Co stores.

Northern States Power said it was selected by Sears to install energy efficiency improvements at a store in Minnetonka, Minn., in early 1997. The store will be used as a prototype for energy efficiency upgrades at other Sears stores in the U.S. Midwest.
Sears has more than 2,700 stores including department stores, home furnishings stores, hardware stores and auto parts stores.

Sears spokeswoman said other energy providers participating in the regional energy alliance include Enova Corp, Entergy Corp, American Electric Power Co, the FPL Energy Services unit of Florida Power & Light Co and Houston Light and Power division of Houston Industries Inc The spokeswoman declined to identify the other two utilities involved in the nationwide project.
Northern States stock closed unchanged Monday at 45-7/8 on the New York Stock Exchange.
